mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations (id, user_id, hotel_id, room_id, check_in, check_out, status, request_note, total_price, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{hotelId}, #{roomId}, #{checkIn}, #{checkOut}, #{status}, #{requestNote}, #{totalPrice}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT res.id AS id, h.id AS hotelId, h.name AS hotelName, r.name AS roomName, res.check_in AS checkIn, res.check_out AS checkOut, (res.check_out - res.check_in) AS nights, res.total_price AS totalPrice, res.status AS status, res.request_note AS requestNote, res.created_at AS createdAt FROM reservations res JOIN hotels h ON h.id = res.hotel_id JOIN rooms r ON r.id = res.room_id WHERE res.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY res.created_at DESC
